About this item

  • THE TOOTHBRUSH THAT FLOSSES FOR YOU: The Waterpik Sonic-Fusion Professional flossing toothbrush combines the power of an advanced sonic electric toothbrush with the proven effectiveness of the Waterpik water flosser.
  • 3 CLEANING MODES: Brush, floss, or both with the touch of a button, for easy and complete oral care with one convenient device. It’s clinically proven up to 2X as effective as traditional brushing and flossing for reducing plaque and improving gum health.
  • DENTIST RECOMMENDED: Waterpik is the #1 water flosser brand recommended by dental professionals and the first water flosser brand to earn the American Dental Association (ADA) Seal of Acceptance for safety and effectiveness.
  • KEY FEATURES: The rechargeable handle charges in the base and includes a 2-minute brushing timer with 30-second pacer, 2 toothbrush speeds, and recharge indicator; built-in electric water flosser includes 10 pressure settings and 60 secs of floss time.
  • INCLUDED: Sonic-Fusion 2.0 Professional, 16 oz removable reservoir for easy cleaning and filling, 2 flossing brush heads (1 compact, 1 full size), 2 brush head covers, toothbrush travel case, magnetic brush head storage post, global voltage.
  • WARRANTY AND SUPPORT: Backed by a 3-year limited manufacturer’s warranty, see manual for details. Waterpik’s Colorado support team is available to help with any product questions or needs.

Important information

Safety Information

Do not direct water under the tongue, into the ear, nose or other delicate areas. Only use tips and accessories recommended by Water Pik, Inc. Use this product only as indicated in the instruction manual or as recommended by your dental professional.

Directions

Brush: Place brush head in mouth, press Brush button, use light pressure and clean all tooth surfaces. Floss: Lean over sink, place brush head in partially closed mouth, press Floss button, follow gumline. Brush + Floss: Place brush head in partially closed mouth. Lean over the sink, press Brush and Floss buttons.

Product Description

Transform your daily oral care routine with the Waterpik Sonic Fusion 2.0 Professional flossing toothbrush, an innovative electric toothbrush with water flosser combo that delivers comprehensive dental cleaning in one convenient device. This advanced flossing toothbrush combines powerful sonic technology with proven Waterpik water flossing effectiveness, making it the ultimate solution for superior oral hygiene at home. It is a great solution for anyone who wants to simplify their oral care routine and improve gum health. The Waterpik Sonic-Fusion 2.0 features 3 distinct cleaning modes that adapt to your specific needs. Choose brush mode for traditional sonic toothbrush cleaning, floss mode for targeted water flosser irrigation, or combine both together. It removes up to 99.9% of plaque bacteria from treated areas that cause gingivitis, cavities, and bad breath and is clinically proven up to 2X as effective as traditional brushing and flossing. Sonic-Fusion includes 10 customizable water flosser settings and provides 60 seconds of continuous floss time, ensuring thorough cleaning between teeth and below the gumline. The built-in 2-minute brushing timer with 30-second pacer guides optimal brushing technique, while the recharge indicator keeps you informed of battery status for the toothbrush. This complete oral irrigator package includes a 16 oz removable reservoir for easy filling and cleaning, 2 flossing brush heads in compact and full sizes, 2 protective brush head covers, a premium travel case, and a magnetic brush head storage post. Waterpik is the #1 water flosser brand recommended by dental professionals, and the Waterpik Sonic-Fusion 2.0 is accepted by the American Dental Association (ADA) for safety and effectiveness. Backed by a 3-year manufacturer's limited warranty, see product manual for details.

  • How do I use the brush and floss modes?

    You can choose how to use based on your preferred oral care routine:

    Brush only: Press Brush, change speed (low/high) by pressing the Speed button

    Water Floss only: Press Floss

    Brush + Water Floss: Press Brush, then press Floss

  • Are replacement brush heads available?

    Two sizes of Genuine Waterpik Sonic-Fusion brush heads are available. The unit comes with both sizes:

    1 Sonic-Fusion Full-Size Brush Head (SFFB-2EW)

    1 Sonic-Fusion Compact Brush Head (SFRB-2EW)

    For best performance, replace every 3 months.

  • Is the toothbrush battery operated? Does the flossing function require electric power?

    Brush mode uses battery power; Floss and Brush + Floss modes use electric power (required for water flossing)

    The power handle charges in the base of the unit

    To detach for hose-free brushing or travel, press the round button on the power handle base

  • What water pressure setting should I use? Is this product suitable for sensitive gums?

    Waterpik water flossers are safe and effective on all settings. First time users or those with sensitive gums should start at the lowest setting. As your gums strengthen over time, increase the pressure to the highest setting that feels comfortable.

  • Is this product easy to clean and maintain?

    Yes, reservoir is removable & top rack dishwasher safe (air dry or turn off heated cycle).

    Monthly: Add 1 part white vinegar to 2 parts warm water to reservoir and run through unit. Rinse by repeating with a full reservoir of warm water.

This is an amazing setup and actually the second one I’ve bought. The first lasted about 5 years before it started to get worn and dirty from regular use. This completely changed that routine—it does the job thoroughly and makes flossing easy and consistent. My gums have never been healthier since using it. Overall, it’s one of those products I wish I had started using sooner.

    I had an old waterpik which had seen better days. I had a sonic toothbrush which made my teeth feel wonderful but gave me repetitive stress issues. I finally decided to spend the money on this combo unit and it really is better than the the sum of its parts. It finds all the little hidden bits of leaves and such that distress one's teeth while efficiently cleaning that all important gumline. That is, it does exactly what it's supposed to do. And there's no spitting! Bonus!

    So, only *mostly* love, because it's just a little too smart for its own good. The brush pulses to make four time divisions then turns off. The only way to have enough water to make it to the end is to have it overflow while filling. Filled up to what looks like the same point is not sufficient. I'm big on saving water, but just a tad more generosity in the tank would actually save water. The old hunch is necessary while doing the combination, or else water will run down one's forearm. I'm not sure if there could be any design solution to that, but it's the brushing part that takes that long. Those who can't hunch can use the brushing part and waterpik part separately. It was hard at first to set the toothbrush in the receptacle, but I learned that holding the hose coil in place, against the unit, it's much easier to seat the brush.

    The only really bad thing about this is the price--and I paid up not to have black. :)

    One thing to know is that although its advertised that you can brush and floss at the same time, the actual application of this concept leaves something to be desired. When you activate the floss and bruch together feature, the flossing rinses all the toothpaste from you mouth before it can be used. So, I brush, then floss. The deep clean is amazing and this has enough power. The brush is set for two minutes and the it will stop automatically. FLAW: if you pause it briefly while brushing, the two minutes restarts. Unlike my phillips sonic care, which you could pause and restart without resetting the two minute time limit. This comes with two heads, one normal size and one for travel, i found they work equally well until one literally broke off in my mouth. I ordered more from Amazon and they have lasted well, so maybe a fluke. Bottom line: This thing does what it does well, but one must be patient and brush first, then floor. Also, don't forget to fill the water reservoir with warm water prior to using flosser. The flosser is super powerful and will clean the heck out of your teeth. Which, as I think about it, is the entire purpose of this thing: clean teeth. This doesn't disappoint.

    TLDR: If somehow the flosser doesn't respond to the toothbrush's signals and the radio and toothbrush resets don’t work, drain the toothbrush's battery completely by setting it idle for a week or so and reconnect the set to power. Make sure you place the toothbrush in the base before reconnecting the set to power.

    Waterpik offers great customer service and the device works great and does what it's supposed to do most of the time.

    -----------------------------------------

    I bought one 2.5 years ago, and after less than 2 months of using it, the flosser stopped responding to the toothbrush's command. I don't know how it happened but I knew it was a housekeeper who unplugged the device as he had to clean the counter. After a few days of testing the flossing function and trying the troubleshooting techniques without success, I gave up and contacted Waterpik's customer service. They asked for anything, you know, that would allow them to honor the warranty. The process was a bit annoying (just a bit, and is absolutely nothing compared to arguing with insurance about coverage) but Waterpik in the end sent me another set for free which I'm still using today.

    Being the environmentally conscious and lazy person I am, I kept the first set because it'd be a chore to dispose of it properly, so I just put it into the original packaging and stored it in the vanity cabinet. Last year, I had to move to another state and while I was packing stuff up, I saw the set and decided to give it another try before completely throwing it away. And it xxxxing worked!!!!!! Now that I commute in between cities, I've placed one at the residence close to my workplace!!! Also I've been periodontitis free for the past 2 years! Thanks Waterpik!!

    Unfortunately, I don't recommend this product for the following reasons:

    1) The button to turn on/off the water flosser is directly below the button to turn on/off the toothbrush. I can't count the number of times that I've inadvertently pressed the flosser button and water sprays everywhere. It's easy to press this button because of its location on the toothbrush, and also because the handle for the toothbrush is small in diameter and slippery when wet...and of course it's going to get wet...so it's tough to avoid pressing buttons while trying to hold onto it. I can disconnect the water flosser to avoid this problem, but that defeats the purpose imho and is a hassle.

    2) I seem to spend an inordinate amount of time keeping this unit clean. The toothbrush and base have lots of crevices.

    3) At this price, I expected a better product, especially from Waterpik. It’s just meh. Not great, not terrible. I can work around the above annoyances, but wish I hadn’t spent so much money on it.

    I gave it 3 stars because the water flosser does a good job, and the reservoir holds a sufficient amount of water compared to the "all-in-one" models, where the water reservoir is in the handle.

    If you have a dental implant, you need a water flosser. Once this toothbrush/flosser needs replacing, I'll look for a different design. Hopefully Waterpik will come up with something better.

    UPDATE: Not long after giving this product 3 stars and a "Meh" review, the flosser stopped working. Actually, it won't STOP working, and wants to run continuously when the unit is plugged in. Now all I have is an expensive electric toothbrush. It gets one star.

About this Item

  • THE TOOTHBRUSH THAT FLOSSES FOR YOU: The Waterpik Sonic-Fusion Professional flossing toothbrush combines the power of an advanced sonic electric toothbrush with the proven effectiveness of the Waterpik water flosser.
  • 3 CLEANING MODES: Brush, floss, or both with the touch of a button, for easy and complete oral care with one convenient device. It’s clinically proven up to 2X as effective as traditional brushing and flossing for reducing plaque and improving gum health.
  • DENTIST RECOMMENDED: Waterpik is the #1 water flosser brand recommended by dental professionals and the first water flosser brand to earn the American Dental Association (ADA) Seal of Acceptance for safety and effectiveness.
  • KEY FEATURES: The rechargeable handle charges in the base and includes a 2-minute brushing timer with 30-second pacer, 2 toothbrush speeds, and recharge indicator; built-in electric water flosser includes 10 pressure settings and 60 secs of floss time.
  • INCLUDED: Sonic-Fusion 2.0 Professional, 16 oz removable reservoir for easy cleaning and filling, 2 flossing brush heads (1 compact, 1 full size), 2 brush head covers, toothbrush travel case, magnetic brush head storage post, global voltage.
  • WARRANTY AND SUPPORT: Backed by a 3-year limited manufacturer’s warranty, see manual for details. Waterpik’s Colorado support team is available to help with any product questions or needs.

Product Description

Transform your daily oral care routine with the Waterpik Sonic Fusion 2.0 Professional flossing toothbrush, an innovative electric toothbrush with water flosser combo that delivers comprehensive dental cleaning in one convenient device. This advanced flossing toothbrush combines powerful sonic technology with proven Waterpik water flossing effectiveness, making it the ultimate solution for superior oral hygiene at home. It is a great solution for anyone who wants to simplify their oral care routine and improve gum health. The Waterpik Sonic-Fusion 2.0 features 3 distinct cleaning modes that adapt to your specific needs. Choose brush mode for traditional sonic toothbrush cleaning, floss mode for targeted water flosser irrigation, or combine both together. It removes up to 99.9% of plaque bacteria from treated areas that cause gingivitis, cavities, and bad breath and is clinically proven up to 2X as effective as traditional brushing and flossing. Sonic-Fusion includes 10 customizable water flosser settings and provides 60 seconds of continuous floss time, ensuring thorough cleaning between teeth and below the gumline. The built-in 2-minute brushing timer with 30-second pacer guides optimal brushing technique, while the recharge indicator keeps you informed of battery status for the toothbrush. This complete oral irrigator package includes a 16 oz removable reservoir for easy filling and cleaning, 2 flossing brush heads in compact and full sizes, 2 protective brush head covers, a premium travel case, and a magnetic brush head storage post. Waterpik is the #1 water flosser brand recommended by dental professionals, and the Waterpik Sonic-Fusion 2.0 is accepted by the American Dental Association (ADA) for safety and effectiveness. Backed by a 3-year manufacturer's limited warranty, see product manual for details.

Important Information

Safety Information

Do not direct water under the tongue, into the ear, nose or other delicate areas. Only use tips and accessories recommended by Water Pik, Inc. Use this product only as indicated in the instruction manual or as recommended by your dental professional.

Directions

Brush: Place brush head in mouth, press Brush button, use light pressure and clean all tooth surfaces. Floss: Lean over sink, place brush head in partially closed mouth, press Floss button, follow gumline. Brush + Floss: Place brush head in partially closed mouth. Lean over the sink, press Brush and Floss buttons.
